statusSignedIn: Signed in · browser records save to cloud on request
statusPrivate: Private to this browser · not cloud-saved
title: Your private account
subtitle: You control when records leave this browser.
notConfiguredTitle: Cloud sign-in is not configured yet.
notConfigured: Browser tracking works, but this is not a production-ready cloud account. Supabase Auth configuration and the reviewed database migration are required. Never put keys or database passwords into this page.
signedInSuffix: . Your account does not automatically upload or replace browser records.
sharedDevice: On a shared device, sign out and clear the browser records separately. Signing out does not erase your local copy.
passwordHelp: Use a unique password of at least 12 characters.
deleteAccountDescription: Deletes your sign-in identity and cloud financial records. Browser records and the separate early-access registration remain. Export a backup before deleting anything.
deletionUnavailable: Provider-side account deletion is not configured yet. Deleting cloud records above does not delete your identity.
emailFlowsUnavailable: Email links are not enabled until the approved callback URL is configured in Supabase. Existing accounts can still sign in.
earlyAccessSeparate: Interest registration on the welcome page is separate from a personal account. Passwords are never saved in browser storage.
confirmSaveCloud: Save this browser’s personal financial records to your account? This does not connect a bank or make a transaction.
confirmLoadCloud: Replace the records currently visible in this browser with your cloud copy? Export a browser backup first if you want to keep both.
confirmDeleteCloud: This permanently deletes your cloud financial records, not your sign-in account or this browser copy. Type {{token}} to confirm.
confirmDeleteAccount: Permanently delete this sign-in account and its cloud financial records? This cannot be undone. Browser records and the separate early-access registration are not erased. Type {{token}} to confirm.

notices.recoveryVerified: Recovery verified. Choose a new password below.
notices.emailConfirmed: Email confirmed. You are signed in. Browser records have not been uploaded automatically.
notices.recoveryRequested: If recovery is available for this account, check your email.
notices.signupRequested: Check your email if confirmation is required. You can then sign in.
notices.signedIn: Signed in. Cloud records are not loaded or overwritten automatically.
notices.cloudSaved: Saved to your private account. Later browser changes still require “Save to cloud”.
notices.noCloudRecords: No cloud records yet. Nothing in this browser was changed.
notices.cloudLoaded: Cloud records loaded into this browser.
notices.cloudDeleted: Cloud financial records deleted. Your browser copy is unchanged. Sign-in account deletion is a separate process.
notices.passwordUpdated: Password updated. Sign in again if requested.
notices.accountDeleted: Your sign-in account and its cloud financial records were deleted. Browser records were not erased.
notices.signedOut: Signed out. Financial records remain in this browser. Clear them in Browser storage before sharing this device.

errors.accountChanged: Your signed-in account changed in another session. No cloud operation was performed. Review the current account before trying again.
errors.cloudConflict: Cloud records changed in another session. Download a backup, then load the latest cloud copy before saving again.
errors.alreadyHasCloud: This account already has cloud records. Load the cloud copy first to prevent accidental replacement. Export your browser records before loading.
errors.sampleRecords: Sample records cannot be uploaded as personal finances. Start your own records first.
errors.passwordMismatch: The new passwords do not match.
errors.emailLinkInvalid: That email link could not be verified. Start again and open the latest link in the same browser where you requested it.
errors.recoveryNotConfigured: Email recovery redirects are not configured yet.
errors.confirmationNotConfigured: Email confirmation redirects are not configured yet.
errors.deleteUnavailable: Account deletion is unavailable until secure provider-side deletion is configured.
errors.confirmPassword: Confirm your current password to delete this account.
errors.deleteFailed: Unable to delete the account. Please try again later.
errors.serviceUnavailable: This request could not be completed. Check the connection and try again.
